Test that stalled, timeupdate and waiting events are sent when media load stalls in the middle.

RUN(video.play())
EVENT(durationchange)
EVENT(loadedmetadata)
EVENT(loadeddata)
EVENT(canplay)
EVENT(timeupdate)
EVENT(waiting)
EVENT(stalled)
END OF TEST
